School.title: School
School.description: Represents a school and its primary information, including access credentials for its public board.

id.description: Unique identifier for the School entity.

name.description: The official name of the school.

boardAccessPin.description: A numeric PIN used to unlock and view the school's public information board. This is for board access, not user authentication.

boardConfigurationId.description: Reference to the BoardConfiguration associated with this school. (Relationship: School 1:1 BoardConfiguration)

BoardConfiguration.title: BoardConfiguration
BoardConfiguration.description: Defines the customizable settings and visual appearance for a school's public information board.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BoardConfiguration entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this configuration belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:1 BoardConfiguration)

themeColor.description: The primary color (hex code) for the board's user interface, e.g., '#30475E'.

backgroundColor.description: The background color (hex code) for the board's user interface, e.g., '#F0F4F8'.

accentColor.description: The accent color (hex code) for interactive elements, e.g., '#6A4C93'.

logoUrl.description: URL of the school's logo to be displayed on the board.

emergencyModeActive.description: Indicates if the emergency announcement mode is currently active.

emergencyMessage.description: The content of the emergency announcement message to be displayed when emergency mode is active.

lessonSchedule.description: An ordered list of lessons for the school's daily schedule.

bellSoundSettings.description: A collection of default bell sounds for different event triggers (e.g., lesson start, lesson end).

LessonScheduleItem.title: LessonScheduleItem
LessonScheduleItem.description: Represents a single lesson entry within a school's daily schedule.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LessonScheduleItem entity.

boardConfigurationId.description: Reference to the BoardConfiguration this lesson schedule item belongs to. (Relationship: BoardConfiguration 1:N LessonScheduleItem)

lessonNumber.description: The sequential number of the lesson (e.g., 1 for 1st lesson, 2 for 2nd lesson).

startTime.description: The start time of the lesson in HH:MM format.

endTime.description: The end time of the lesson in HH:MM format.

bellSoundUrl.description: Optional URL for a custom bell sound for this specific lesson, overriding default settings.

BellSoundSetting.title: BellSoundSetting
BellSoundSetting.description: Defines a specific bell sound for a particular trigger event (e.g., lesson start, end).

id.description: Unique identifier for the BellSoundSetting entity.

boardConfigurationId.description: Reference to the BoardConfiguration this bell sound setting belongs to. (Relationship: BoardConfiguration 1:N BellSoundSetting)

triggerType.description: The type of event that triggers this bell sound (e.g., 'lessonStart', 'lessonEnd', 'breakStart', 'breakEnd').

soundUrl.description: URL of the audio file for this bell sound.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Represents an informational announcement displayed on the board's main content area.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Announcement entity.

boardConfigurationId.description: Reference to the BoardConfiguration this announcement belongs to. (Relationship: BoardConfiguration 1:N Announcement)

description.description: The detailed text content of the announcement.

imageUrl.description: Optional URL for an image associated with the announcement.

isActive.description: Indicates if the announcement is currently active and should be displayed.

themeColor.description: Optional override color (hex code) for the announcement's display card.

iconUrl.description: Optional URL for an icon associated with the announcement.

displayOrder.description: A number indicating the order in which this announcement should be displayed in a grouped layout or slider.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the announcement was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the announcement was last updated.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents a scheduled event with specific start and end dates, to be displayed on the information board.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Event entity.

boardConfigurationId.description: Reference to the BoardConfiguration this event belongs to. (Relationship: BoardConfiguration 1:N Event)

description.description: A detailed description of the event.

imageUrl.description: Optional URL for an image associated with the event.

startDate.description: The date and time when the event starts.

endDate.description: The date and time when the event ends.

isActive.description: Indicates if the event is currently active and should be displayed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the event was first created.

AdminLog.title: AdminLog
AdminLog.description: Records administrative actions performed on a specific school board, including who made the change and what was changed.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AdminLog entry.

adminId.description: Identifier of the administrator who performed the action (from an external authentication system).

boardConfigurationId.description: Reference to the BoardConfiguration where the change occurred. (Relationship: BoardConfiguration 1:N AdminLog)

entityType.description: The type of data entity that was affected by the action (e.g., 'Announcement', 'LessonScheduleItem', 'BoardConfiguration').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the specific entity instance that was affected.

changeDescription.description: A human-readable summary or details of the changes made.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the administrative action was performed.

AnnouncementVersion.title: AnnouncementVersion
AnnouncementVersion.description: Stores previous versions of announcements, allowing administrators to review and restore past states.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AnnouncementVersion entry.

announcementId.description: Reference to the original Announcement this version belongs to. (Relationship: Announcement 1:N AnnouncementVersion)

boardConfigurationId.description: Reference to the BoardConfiguration for context and filtering. (Relationship: BoardConfiguration 1:N AnnouncementVersion)

versionTimestamp.description: The date and time when this version of the announcement was saved.

versionData.description: A JSON string representation of the full Announcement document at the time this version was saved, for restoration purposes.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure prioritizes secure, scalable, and debuggable authorization by adhering to the core design principles and strategy mandates. The central theme is **Authorization Independence via Denormalization** and **Structural Segregation** to simplify security rules.

**Authorization Independence:** The most critical aspect is eliminating `get()` calls in security rules for authorization checks. This is achieved by denormalizing key authorization context into every document where access needs to be controlled. Specifically:
1.  Each `BoardConfiguration` document will include an `adminMembers` map (`map<uid, role>`). This map defines which Firebase UIDs have administrative privileges for that specific school board.
2.  All sub-entities of a `BoardConfiguration` (e.g., `LessonScheduleItem`, `BellSoundSetting`, `Announcement`, `Event`, `AdminLog`, `AnnouncementVersion`) will redundantly store `schoolId`, `boardConfigurationId`, and the `adminMembers` map from their parent `BoardConfiguration`. This means that when an administrator attempts to modify an announcement, the security rule can directly check `resource.data.adminMembers[request.auth.uid] != null` on the `Announcement` document itself, without needing to perform a `get()` operation on its parent `BoardConfiguration` or `School`. This ensures atomic operations, simplifies rule logic, and enhances debuggability.

**Structural Segregation & QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
1.  **Public School Discovery:** The top-level `/schools` collection allows for public listing (`list` operation) of school names and IDs without exposing any sensitive information. This fulfills Queryable Access Patterns (QAPs) for initial school discovery.
2.  **Board Access (PIN-controlled):** To view a specific school's board, the client must provide a `boardAccessPin`. This initial 'unlock' is performed via a `get()` operation on the `schools/{schoolId}/boardConfigurations/{boardConfigurationId}` document, where the rule verifies the provided PIN against the `boardAccessPin` field in that document. This is an acceptable single `get()` operation for initial access.
3.  **Public Board Content (QAPs for lists):** Once a board is 'unlocked', its subcollections like `announcements` and `events` need to be queried in real-time. To support `list` operations (QAPs) without `get()` calls per document, all public-facing subcollection documents (e.g., `announcements/{announcementId}`, `events/{eventId}`, `lessonScheduleItems/{lessonScheduleItemId}`, `bellSoundSettings/{bellSoundSettingId}`) explicitly include `schoolId` and `boardConfigurationId` as fields. Security rules can then enforce that any `list` query for these subcollections includes a `where('boardConfigurationId', '==', '{boardConfigurationId_from_unlocked_parent}')` clause, allowing the rule to directly compare `resource.data.boardConfigurationId` with the path parameter/query without additional `get()` calls. This enables efficient and secure real-time streaming of public board content.
4.  **Admin-Only Data:** Sensitive data like `adminLogs` and `announcementVersions` are nested deeply (`/schools/{schoolId}/boardConfigurations/{boardConfigurationId}/adminLogs/{adminLogId}` and `/schools/{schoolId}/boardConfigurations/{boardConfigurationId}/announcements/{announcementId}/versions/{announcementVersionId}`). Their access is restricted solely to authorized admins, enforced by the denormalized `adminMembers` map within each document, further solidifying structural segregation.

**Access Modeling:** A clear hierarchical path structure (`/schools/{schoolId}/boardConfigurations/{boardConfigurationId}/...`) is used for user-owned and collaborative data, making ownership and relationships explicit. Global roles are not used; instead, the `adminMembers` map provides document-level, collaborative authorization.

**Data Clarity and Predictability:** Semantic naming conventions are used for paths and wildcards (e.g., `{schoolId}`). The use of a boolean `isActive` field clearly models document state. Timestamps (`createdAt`, `updatedAt`) are standard for auditability. The arrays for `lessonSchedule` and `bellSoundSettings` in the `BoardConfiguration` schema are replaced by dedicated subcollections (`lessonScheduleItems` and `bellSoundSettings`) to allow for individual management and more complex entity structures, as indicated by their separate entity definitions.
